name: What factors influence the lifespan of hardwood flooring?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the lifespan of hardwood flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of hardwood flooring is influenced by several factors, including the quality of the wood, the expertise of the installation, the amount of foot traffic it receives, and the consistency of maintenance. Proper care, such as regular cleaning and prompt attention to spills, significantly extends its life. The ability to refinish solid hardwood multiple times also contributes to its longevity, allowing it to look new for decades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Lifespan is affected by wood quality, installation, traffic, and maintenance. Proper care and refinishing can significantly extend its durability.
